observations: A skull-like form fills the center against a dark gray field, outlined in white with two large circular eye sockets, each ringed by a jagged yellow-gold scalloped border and dense black radiating lines.
Bold diagonal bands of deep red and yellow cut across the upper background, while loose blue and red scribbled lines extend beyond the skull's edges in multiple directions.
The lower jaw shows a row of white rectangular teeth; the right eye socket contains a grid of crossing lines, while the left holds a smaller dark oval, making the two sockets visibly asymmetrical.
reading: The skull form sits close and frontal, its white outline holding steady while blue scribbles drift outward and red bands slice the background at angles. The two eye sockets differ — one gridded, one a plain dark oval — giving the face an off-balance quality that reads as unease rather than menace. Yellow-gold scalloped rings around each socket add a decorative note that sits oddly against the dark ground.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work's dark gray ground and spare palette contrast sharply with the dense multicolor field of title neighbor nnotb #142. The collector links nnxyz to scrimshaw through pattern and line — the scalloped eye rings and radiating marks speak directly to that visual connection.

connections.reason: Both works center a broad, roughly square face with a prominent tooth row at the bottom and loose scribbled lines extending beyond the face boundary, though nifty faces #108 uses a saturated multicolor ground against this work's dark gray.

lookingQuestion: What does the difference between the gridded right eye socket and the plain left one do to how you read the face as a whole?
ambiguities: nnotb #144's pink ground and abstract spiral forms offer no strong formal parallel to this work's skull structure, so it was not selected as a connection.
The scribbled marks extending beyond the skull boundary could be read as background texture or as separate drawn elements; the image does not resolve this clearly.
